newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FX FUTURES TURNOVER LOWEST THIS YEAR.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FX FUTURES TURNOVER LOWEST THIS YEAR.

text.p: Uncertainties over spot movements in the dollar/mark kept Hungary's currency futures traders on the sidelines, with the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) registering its lowest turnover this year.
The BCE saw turnover of just 378 million forints, shared between the dollar, mark and yen.
The mark rose for September and December while the dollar eased for most maturites except June, which ended stable. The yen fell for December and March.
The Budapest Stock Exchange forex futures market was tradeless.
